notes.title: Release MEMOLOGY: ITALIAN BRAINROT
notes.notes:
Most likely, everyone has already heard about Brainrot? Can you guess the names of each Italian animal? Test your knowledge about them in the new part of Memology: MEMOLOGY: ITALIAN BRAINROT!

Recently, there have been many games dedicated to Italian brainrot. But have you seen many really well-developed games on this topic? In this version of the game, the music is made by AI tools. The voice acting of AI characters has also been worked out, which has come to life due to her in the already familiar quiz format.

Rather, purchase a new memology with a 40% discount in honor of its release.
